newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian shares end up on U.S., German gains.
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares end up on U.S., German gains.

text.p: 1340 GMT - Austria's ATX index ends firmer on Wednesday on strong international leads after benign U.S. inflation data indicates lower probability of an imminent U.S. rate hike. Robust performance from Creditanstalt preferred, beverage group BBAG and brewer unit Brau Unit. ATX seen stable to Friday.
* ATX index up 5.30 points or 0.42 percent at 1,261.47.
* Top gainer Creditanstalt preferred, up 4.54 at 505.60 ats
* Fireproof material maker Radex Heraklith RHIV biggest decliner, down 0.94 at 525 ats.
* May ATX contract up 19.10 points at 1,259.0 -- Vienna newsroom, +431 53112 257
